## Accessibility and code audit

Run on 2026-11-05, against the code at commit 09.

**Contrast.** Computed from `src/styles/tokens.css`, on the lightest background each text can sit on. Normal text needs 4.5:1, large text 3:1.

| Text | Ratio | Mockup value |
|---|---|---|
| Section numbers on the sheet | 5.78:1 | 2.51:1 |
| Deleted text on the navy card, at the lightest possible navy | 5.61:1 | 2.73:1 |
| Inactive palette items, large text, darkest and lightest backdrop | 3.94:1 and 3.07:1 | 2.50:1 |
| Muted text on the app background | 5.22:1 | same |
| Card body text at the card's far corner | 8.92:1 | same |
| Card labels at the card's far corner | 6.98:1 | same |
| Added text on its tint | 8.11:1 | changed with the card |
| Refine field placeholder | 4.81:1 | same |
| Apply button, ink on sky | 7.65:1 | same |
| Toast Undo, sky on navy | 7.65:1 | same |

**Limits.** These ratios ignore the grain texture, which adds small white specks to the navy. The inactive palette items at 3.07:1 have the least margin. Nothing here was checked with a screen reader.

**Targets.** Every control that takes keyboard focus measured at least 44px in a browser. The clickable changes inside the diff are the deliberate exception: they are as tall as the text and out of the tab order, and the row below them is the 44px path to the same actions (decision 10).

**Code checks, by search.** No raw colors outside `tokens.css`. No `fetch` outside `src/api/`. No `useState`, `useReducer`, `useEffect` or `useRef` in `src/components/`. No `VITE_` variables. The built `dist/` contains neither the key's variable name nor an OpenRouter key prefix.

**Browser checks.** Each flow was also driven in a real browser (Edge, through Playwright) against `pnpm dev` and the real model. Those scripts lived outside the repo and are not repeatable from it, so where a row cites a browser run, that is evidence from this session, not a test you can rerun. Playwright is not a project dependency.

Blaze is built through step c: all 9 commits are in, in your order, and nothing is pushed. A fresh clone installs and passes lint, all 232 tests and the build. I also ran each flow in a real browser against the real model.

## Model recommendation: Claude Sonnet 5.5
I ran each model 3 times per paragraph and instruction, 54 calls in all. The 3 runs were already in the first batch, so nothing needed re-running.

| | Haiku 5.5 | GPT-6 Luna | **Sonnet 5.5** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Same number of changes between runs | 44% | 39% | **78%** |
| Same facts kept between runs | 78% | 89% | **100%** |
| Checklist facts kept | 98% | 92% | **100%** |
| Replies adding a claim (my reading) | 6 of 18 | 1 of 18 | **0 of 18** |
| Replies dropping a claim (my reading) | 1 of 18 | 6 of 18 | **0 of 18** |
| Median time, first request / refine | 2.1 s / 2.4 s | 2.6 s / 5.5 s | 2.2 s / 4.9 s |
| Average cost per call | $0.00017 | $0.00015 | $0.00461 |

- **Why Sonnet:** Haiku adds commitments ("we want to fix it"), and Luna dropped "until the end of the day" while claiming it kept the key points. A user is least likely to catch those two failures.
- **Cost:** Sonnet is about 27 times Haiku's price, but the $5 cap still allows roughly 1,000 calls.
- **Limits:** I wrote the fact checklist after reading the replies, and the "my reading" rows are my judgment. The raw replies are in `docs/model-comparison.json`, and `NOTES.md` states these limits.

**Section context stays.** It used the real baseline in 3 of 3 runs against 0 of 3 without it, and named the right subject in 3 of 3 against 0 of 3. It never repeated the context, and it costs about 2% more. I picked two of those passages because context could help there, so this shows it can help, not how often.

## Your other requests
- **`/` with nothing selected:** it acts on the current section and names it before running. A title with no text of its own has no target, and a document with no headings targets the current paragraph.
- **Free text:** the Ask field is in the pill and the palette, and it works on the first request.
- **Restructuring:** only section targets may reorder, merge or split.
- **Wording:** `NOTES.md` now describes a deliberately single-step agent.
- **Matrix:** rebuilt with the brief's exact wording, including your new rows and the no-zod decision.

## What went wrong along the way
- **I broke your commit rule once.** Commit 03 went through with a failing lint, because my command printed the result without stopping on it. I fixed it and amended that local commit, and every later commit had to pass lint, tests and build first.
- **I rewrote one claim.** I had written that restructures usually show as a block, but a real one came out as 4 separate changes, so I corrected `NOTES.md`.

The browser runs and tests also caught four real bugs, all fixed:
- Ctrl+Z did nothing after clicking Apply.
- The pill didn't come back after Cancel.
- Esc couldn't close the palette when it had no target.
- `[X]` placeholders showed with stray backslashes in the diff.

## Still open
- **Matrix rows not finished:**
  - **README and related:** D2, E4, E5 and S40 wait on the README, which is still the Vite template and mentions Oxlint.
  - **Delivery:** D1, D3 and E3 wait on the repo link and session files.
  - **Your own walkthrough:** B5 and N2 need you to use it yourself, since "feels collaborative" isn't something I can test.
- **Spend:** the two comparisons cost a measured $0.14. The browser runs add perhaps $0.10–0.15 more, which is my estimate, so check your OpenRouter dashboard for the real total.
- **Accessibility limits:** contrast ratios ignore the grain texture, and nothing was tested with a screen reader.
- **Port:** Vite moved Blaze to 5174 because your other project holds 5173, so the README should say to use the URL it prints. That project is still running.

## Questions for you
1. **Should I write the README next?** It wasn't in your build order, but the brief requires it. I recommend yes.
2. **Should a moved block be all-or-nothing?** Moved text counts as one removal plus one addition, so keeping only the addition leaves it in the document twice. It's visible in the diff and logged as a known gap. I'd treat any restructured section as a single before/after block, which is a small change, but it goes beyond your 60% rule, so it's your call.
3. **Should the browser checks go in the repo?** They're in my scratch folder, so three of those four bugs (the `[X]` one has a test) have no test you can re-run. Adding Playwright would fix that but adds a dependency you didn't list. With limited time I'd leave it out and list it under "with more time" in the README.

Understood on all of it. On waiting for your OK: you're right, I built on the model before you approved it, so I'll save that as a standing rule. Here's the order I'll work in.

**Commit 10, restructured sections as a single block. What I'll do:**
- Add a pure `isRestructured` check that compares blocks (paragraphs, list items, headings): a different count means a merge or split, and blocks out of order mean a reorder.
- It applies only to section targets, because a selection keeps its shape.
- When it triggers, the card shows Before and After with no per-change row, so a moved block can't be left in the document twice.

**Why detect it at all:** making every section a block would take away word-by-word review from plain rewordings, such as "Make 'Why now' shorter".

- **Expensive:** a reorder is accepted and a heading, list or link is lost in the conversion back to the document, or undo restores only part of it. Named tests cover both.

**Any restructured section is one before/after block, all or nothing, whatever share of it changed.** A moved block is one removal and one addition, so keeping only the addition would leave the text in the document twice. In a real run, moving one bullet and merging two others came in under 60% changed and showed as 4 separate changes, which is what prompted this rule.

`isRestructured` in `src/lib/diff.ts` compares blocks (paragraphs, list items, headings). A different count means blocks were merged, split or removed. The same count with blocks matching out of order means a reorder. It applies only to section targets. Rewording a section in place stays word by word.

- **Expensive:** a reorder is accepted and a heading, list or link is lost in the conversion back to the document, or undo restores only part of it. Named tests cover both. Detection can also miss a restructure, for example two blocks swapped and reworded beyond recognition, which would then show as word-by-word changes and could still duplicate text.
- **Cheap:** a false positive. Removing one bullet, or a reword that happens to match another block better, shows as a block, so the user loses word-by-word review of that one suggestion. They can still accept, reject or refine.

A restructure doesn't always pass 60% changed. In a real run, moving one bullet and merging two others came out as 4 separate changes, not a block. Accepted whole, it landed correctly and one undo restored it.

- **Expensive:** a reorder is accepted and a heading, list or link is lost in the conversion back to the document, or undo restores only part of it. Named tests cover both.
- **Known gap:** a moved block is one removal and one addition, so keeping only the addition leaves the text in the document twice. It is valid Markdown and visible in the diff before applying, but nothing prevents it.
- **Cheap:** the model restructures when the user only wanted a rewording. The diff shows it plainly, and the user rejects or refines.
input.new_string:
**Any restructured section is one before/after block, all or nothing, whatever share of it changed.** A moved block is one removal and one addition, so keeping only the addition would leave the text in the document twice. In a real run, moving one bullet and merging two others came in under 60% changed and showed as 4 separate changes, which is what prompted this rule.

`isRestructured` in `src/lib/diff.ts` compares blocks (paragraphs, list items, headings). A different count means blocks were merged, split or removed. The same count with blocks matching out of order means a reorder. It applies only to section targets. Rewording a section in place stays word by word.

- **Expensive:** a reorder is accepted and a heading, list or link is lost in the conversion back to the document, or undo restores only part of it. Named tests cover both. Detection can also miss a restructure, for example two blocks swapped and reworded beyond recognition, which would then show as word-by-word changes and could still duplicate text.
- **Cheap:** a false positive. Removing one bullet, or a reword that happens to match another block better, shows as a block, so the user loses word-by-word review of that one suggestion. They can still accept, reject or refine.

import { card, docText, expect, openApp, pillCommand, SAFE_REWRITE, SAFE_SENTENCE, selectText, test } from './support.ts'

test.describe('first open', () => {
  test('a new user sees the hint and prompts, and one click gets a suggestion', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    const hint = page.getByText('Select any sentence to ask for a rewrite')
    await expect(hint).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Make / })).toHaveCount(3)

    suggest.reply("We'll know it's working when median first response drops from [X] to [Y] by [date].")
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Make the success metric measurable' }).click()

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    await expect(hint).toBeHidden()
    expect(suggest.requests[0]).toMatchObject({
      target: 'section',
      selection: "We'll know it's working when tickets get answered faster.",
      context: { heading: 'Success metrics' },
    })
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('a prompt disappears with its section and returns on undo', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap h2', { hasText: 'Success metrics' }).click({ clickCount: 3 })
    await page.keyboard.press('Backspace')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Make / })).toHaveCount(2)

    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+z')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Make / })).toHaveCount(3)
  })
})

test.describe('asking', () => {
  test('free text works on the first request, and only the selection is sent', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)

    suggest.reply('Should we log every suggestion and whether it was accepted?')
    await selectText(page, SAFE_SENTENCE)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ask', exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByLabel(/What should/).fill('Turn this into a question')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]).toEqual({
      selection: SAFE_SENTENCE,
      target: 'selection',
      instruction: 'Turn this into a question',
      currentSuggestion: null,
      context: {
        heading: "How we'll keep it safe",
        before: null,
        after: null,
      },
    })
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('suggestions work on text the user just typed', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: "We'll know it's working" }).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('End')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await page.keyboard.type('i think this sentance has a typo')

    suggest.reply('I think this sentence has a typo.')
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'sentance' }).click({ clickCount: 3 })
    await page.getByRole('toolbar').getByRole('button', { name: 'Fix grammar' }).click()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.selection).toBe('i think this sentance has a typo')

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' }).click()
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText('I think this sentence has a typo.')
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).not.toContainText('sentance')
  })
})

test.describe('reviewing', () => {
  test('the diff shows in the card and the document stays as it was', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE, 'Tightened the opening.')
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Tightened the opening.')
    await expect(card(page).locator('del').first()).toBeVisible()
    await expect(card(page).locator('ins').first()).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByText('Change 1 of 2')).toBeVisible()
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('partial accept applies only the kept change, and clicking selects a change', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')

    await card(page).getByRole('button', { name: /^Change 2:/ }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText('Change 2 of 2')).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Previous change' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText('Change 1 of 2')).toBeVisible()

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Keep', exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText('Change 2 of 2')).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Discard', exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply · 1 kept, 1 dropped' }).click()

    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText('We will log every suggestion and whether it was accepted')
  })

  test('the toast Undo restores the document in one step', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' }).click()
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText(SAFE_REWRITE)

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Undo' }).click()
    await expect.poll(() => docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('editing the paragraph discards the suggestion with a notice', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const paragraph = page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Every answer' })
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Rewrite')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    await paragraph.click()
    await page.keyboard.type('x')

    await expect(page.getByText('You edited this text, so the suggestion was discarded.')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Nothing to review')
  })

  test('editing another paragraph keeps the suggestion, and accept lands in the right place', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Rewrite')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' }).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('Home')
    await page.keyboard.type('Added words. ')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' }).click()
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Every answer' })).toContainText(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' })).toContainText('Added words. Right now')
  })
})

test.describe('refining', () => {
  test('a refine sends the original, the current suggestion and the instruction', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    suggest.reply('We will record all suggestions and whether each was accepted')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'More formal' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Refine history' })).toBeVisible()

    suggest.reply('We record all suggestions and whether each was accepted')
    await page.getByLabel(/Tell .* what to change/).fill('Drop the future tense')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Refine history' })).toContainText('Drop the future tense')

    expect(suggest.requests.map((request) => request.selection)).toEqual([SAFE_SENTENCE, SAFE_SENTENCE, SAFE_SENTENCE])
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.currentSuggestion).toBeNull()
    expect(suggest.requests[1]?.currentSuggestion).toBe(SAFE_REWRITE)
    expect(suggest.requests[2]?.instruction).toBe('Drop the future tense')
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('stepping back through the history makes no call', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE, 'First answer.')
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')

    suggest.reply('We will record all suggestions and whether each was accepted', 'Second answer.')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Warmer' }).click()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Second answer.')

    await page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Refine history' }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Shorter' }).click()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')
    expect(suggest.requests).toHaveLength(2)
  })
})

test.describe('restructuring', () => {
  const REORDERED = [
    '- Weekly reviews of what the assistant got wrong so we can actually improve it over time.',
    '- An AI assistant that drafts answers for the most common tickets, which an agent always reviews before sending.',
    '- A shared knowledge base so the assistant and the team are working from the same information.',
  ].join('\n')

  test('a restructured section is one block, all or nothing, and one undo restores it', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap li', { hasText: 'A shared knowledge base' }).click()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Commands/ }).click()

    suggest.reply(REORDERED, 'Moved the weekly reviews to the top.')
    await page.getByLabel(/something else/).fill('Put the weekly reviews first')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('This reorganizes the section')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Before')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('After')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Keep', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Discard', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0)
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.target).toBe('section')
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' }).click()
    const items = page.locator('.tiptap li')
    await expect(items).toHaveCount(3)
    await expect(items.first()).toContainText('Weekly reviews')
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap h2')).toHaveCount(4)

    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+z')
    await expect.poll(() => docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('rewording a section in place keeps word-by-word review', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply('Right now the support team spends most of their day answering the same questions.')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Make “Why now” shorter' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Keep', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    await expect(card(page)).not.toContainText('This reorganizes the section')
  })
})

test.describe('loading and cancel', () => {
  test('Cancel aborts the request and leaves the document unchanged', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    const aborted = page.waitForEvent('requestfailed', (request) => request.url().includes('/api/suggest'))

    suggest.hang()
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Thinking')
    await expect(page.locator('.blaze-thinking')).not.toHaveCount(0)

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }).click()
    await aborted

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Nothing to review')
    await expect(page.getByText('Cancelled. Your text is unchanged.')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.locator('.blaze-target-block')).toHaveCount(0)
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('cancelling a refine keeps the suggestion', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE, 'First answer.')
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')

    suggest.hang()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Warmer' }).click()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }).click()

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' })).toHaveCount(0)
  })
})

test.describe('errors', () => {
  for (const { status, code, message, heading } of [
    {
      status: 500,
      code: 'missing_api_key',
      message: 'No API key found. Add OPENROUTER_API_KEY to your .env file and restart.',
      heading: 'Add your API key',
    },
    {
      status: 402,
      code: 'budget_exhausted',
      message: 'The credit on this API key has run out. Your document is unchanged.',
      heading: 'Out of credit',
    },
  ] as const) {
    test(`${code} says what happened and leaves the document unchanged`, async ({ page, suggest }) => {
      await openApp(page)
      const original = await docText(page)
      suggest.fail(status, code, message)
      await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')

      await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toHaveText(message)
      await expect(card(page)).toContainText(heading)
      expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
    })
  }

  test('an unreachable server says so', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.failNetwork()
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText("Can't reach the server")
  })

  test('a failure makes no second call until Retry, which makes exactly one', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.failNetwork()
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toBeVisible()

    // Long enough for any automatic retry to have shown itself.
    await page.waitForTimeout(500)
    expect(suggest.requests).toHaveLength(1)

    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()

    expect(suggest.requests).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(suggest.requests[1]).toEqual(suggest.requests[0])
  })

  test('a failed refine keeps the suggestion and offers Retry', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE, 'First answer.')
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')

    suggest.failNetwork()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Warmer' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toContainText('Your current suggestion is still here.')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()

    suggest.reply('We will warmly log all suggestions and whether it was accepted', 'Second answer.')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }).click()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Second answer.')
    expect(suggest.requests[2]).toEqual(suggest.requests[1])
  })
})

import { card, docText, expect, openApp, outsideEditor, palette, pillCommand, SAFE_REWRITE, SAFE_SENTENCE, selectText, test } from './support.ts'

test.describe('typing stays typing', () => {
  test('"and/or" in a sentence types a slash and opens nothing', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' }).click()
    await page.keyboard.type('and/or')

    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText('and/or')
    await expect(palette(page)).toBeHidden()

    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+z')
    await expect.poll(() => docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('a slash and a question mark in the refine field stay text', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    const field = page.getByLabel(/Tell .* what to change/)
    await field.click()
    await page.keyboard.type('and/or?')

    await expect(field).toHaveValue('and/or?')
    await expect(palette(page)).toBeHidden()
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Shortcuts' })).toBeHidden()
  })
})

test.describe('the / palette', () => {
  test('on an empty line it opens on the current section, and the slash is not typed', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' }).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('End')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await page.keyboard.press('/')

    await expect(palette(page)).toContainText('on “Why now”')
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).not.toContainText('/')
  })

  test('with a selection it runs on the selection, using the arrows and Enter', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await selectText(page, SAFE_SENTENCE)
    await page.keyboard.press('/')
    await expect(palette(page)).toContainText("on “How we'll keep it safe”")

    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown')
    await expect(page.getByRole('option', { selected: true })).toContainText('Shorter')

    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]).toMatchObject({
      target: 'selection',
      selection: SAFE_SENTENCE,
      instruction: 'Make it shorter.',
    })
  })

  test('with nothing selected it acts on the whole section', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' }).click()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Commands/ }).click()
    await expect(palette(page)).toContainText('on “Why now”')

    suggest.reply('The team answers the same questions all day, so harder tickets wait.')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.target).toBe('section')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.selection).toContain('Right now the support team')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.selection).not.toContain('What we')
  })

  test('free text works in the palette', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await selectText(page, SAFE_SENTENCE)
    await page.keyboard.press('/')
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await page.getByLabel(/something else/).fill('Say it in fewer words')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.instruction).toBe('Say it in fewer words')
  })

  test('during a review it refines the suggestion', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('/')
    suggest.reply('We record all suggestions and whether each was accepted')
    await page.getByLabel(/something else/).fill('Use the word record')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')

    await expect(page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Refine history' })).toBeVisible()
    expect(suggest.requests[1]).toMatchObject({
      selection: SAFE_SENTENCE,
      currentSuggestion: SAFE_REWRITE,
      instruction: 'Use the word record',
    })
  })

  test('Esc closes it', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Commands/ }).click()
    await expect(palette(page)).toBeVisible()
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(palette(page)).toBeHidden()
  })
})

test.describe('shortcuts', () => {
  test('Ctrl+Enter accepts all, and Ctrl+Z from outside the editor undoes it', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()

    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+Enter')
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText(SAFE_REWRITE)

    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+z')
    await expect.poll(() => docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('Esc rejects a suggestion', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()

    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Nothing to review')
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('Esc cancels a request in flight', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.hang()
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' })).toBeVisible()

    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Nothing to review')
  })

  test('Esc closes the pill', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await selectText(page, SAFE_SENTENCE)
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(page.getByRole('toolbar')).toBeHidden()
  })

  test('? opens the shortcuts from outside the editor, and Esc closes them', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('?')
    const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Shortcuts' })
    await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(dialog).toBeHidden()
  })

  test('the sidebar buttons open the shortcuts too', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Shortcuts/ }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Shortcuts' })).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Got it' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Shortcuts' })).toBeHidden()
  })
})

import { card, docText, expect, openApp, pillCommand, SAFE_REWRITE, SAFE_SENTENCE, selectText, test } from './support.ts'

test.describe('first open', () => {
  test('a new user sees the hint and prompts, and one click gets a suggestion', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    const hint = page.getByText('Select any sentence to ask for a rewrite')
    await expect(hint).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Make / })).toHaveCount(3)

    suggest.reply("We'll know it's working when median first response drops from [X] to [Y] by [date].")
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Make the success metric measurable' }).click()

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    await expect(hint).toBeHidden()
    expect(suggest.requests[0]).toMatchObject({
      target: 'section',
      selection: "We'll know it's working when tickets get answered faster.",
      context: { heading: 'Success metrics' },
    })
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('a prompt disappears with its section and returns on undo', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap h2', { hasText: 'Success metrics' }).click({ clickCount: 3 })
    await page.keyboard.press('Backspace')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Make / })).toHaveCount(2)

    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+z')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Make / })).toHaveCount(3)
  })
})

test.describe('asking', () => {
  test('free text works on the first request, and only the selection is sent', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)

    suggest.reply('Should we log every suggestion and whether it was accepted?')
    await selectText(page, SAFE_SENTENCE)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ask', exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByLabel(/What should/).fill('Turn this into a question')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]).toEqual({
      selection: SAFE_SENTENCE,
      target: 'selection',
      instruction: 'Turn this into a question',
      currentSuggestion: null,
      context: {
        heading: "How we'll keep it safe",
        before: null,
        after: null,
      },
    })
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('suggestions work on text the user just typed', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: "We'll know it's working" }).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('End')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await page.keyboard.type('i think this sentance has a typo')

    suggest.reply('I think this sentence has a typo.')
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'sentance' }).click({ clickCount: 3 })
    await page.getByRole('toolbar').getByRole('button', { name: 'Fix grammar' }).click()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.selection).toBe('i think this sentance has a typo')

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' }).click()
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText('I think this sentence has a typo.')
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).not.toContainText('sentance')
  })
})

test.describe('reviewing', () => {
  test('the diff shows in the card and the document stays as it was', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE, 'Tightened the opening.')
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Tightened the opening.')
    await expect(card(page).locator('del').first()).toBeVisible()
    await expect(card(page).locator('ins').first()).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByText('Change 1 of 2')).toBeVisible()
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('partial accept applies only the kept change, and clicking selects a change', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')

    await card(page).getByRole('button', { name: /^Change 2:/ }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText('Change 2 of 2')).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Previous change' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText('Change 1 of 2')).toBeVisible()

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Keep', exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText('Change 2 of 2')).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Discard', exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply · 1 kept, 1 dropped' }).click()

    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText('We will log every suggestion and whether it was accepted')
  })

  test('the toast Undo restores the document in one step', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' }).click()
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText(SAFE_REWRITE)

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Undo' }).click()
    await expect.poll(() => docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('editing the paragraph discards the suggestion with a notice', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const paragraph = page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Every answer' })
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Rewrite')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    await paragraph.click()
    await page.keyboard.type('x')

    await expect(page.getByText('You edited this text, so the suggestion was discarded.')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Nothing to review')
  })

  test('editing another paragraph keeps the suggestion, and accept lands in the right place', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Rewrite')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' }).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('Home')
    await page.keyboard.type('Added words. ')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' }).click()
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Every answer' })).toContainText(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' })).toContainText('Added words. Right now')
  })
})

test.describe('refining', () => {
  test('a refine sends the original, the current suggestion and the instruction', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    suggest.reply('We will record all suggestions and whether each was accepted')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'More formal' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Refine history' })).toBeVisible()

    suggest.reply('We record all suggestions and whether each was accepted')
    await page.getByLabel(/Tell .* what to change/).fill('Drop the future tense')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Refine history' })).toContainText('Drop the future tense')

    expect(suggest.requests.map((request) => request.selection)).toEqual([SAFE_SENTENCE, SAFE_SENTENCE, SAFE_SENTENCE])
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.currentSuggestion).toBeNull()
    expect(suggest.requests[1]?.currentSuggestion).toBe(SAFE_REWRITE)
    expect(suggest.requests[2]?.instruction).toBe('Drop the future tense')
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('stepping back through the history makes no call', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE, 'First answer.')
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')

    suggest.reply('We will record all suggestions and whether each was accepted', 'Second answer.')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Warmer' }).click()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Second answer.')

    await page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Refine history' }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Shorter' }).click()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')
    expect(suggest.requests).toHaveLength(2)
  })
})

test.describe('restructuring', () => {
  const REORDERED = [
    '- Weekly reviews of what the assistant got wrong so we can actually improve it over time.',
    '- An AI assistant that drafts answers for the most common tickets, which an agent always reviews before sending.',
    '- A shared knowledge base so the assistant and the team are working from the same information.',
  ].join('\n')

  test('a restructured section is one block, all or nothing, and one undo restores it', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap li', { hasText: 'A shared knowledge base' }).click()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Commands/ }).click()

    suggest.reply(REORDERED, 'Moved the weekly reviews to the top.')
    await page.getByLabel(/something else/).fill('Put the weekly reviews first')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('This reorganizes the section')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Before')

    await expect(items).toHaveCount(3)
    await expect(items.first()).toContainText('Weekly reviews')
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap h2')).toHaveCount(4)

    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+z')
    await expect.poll(() => docText(page)).toBe(original)

  test('rewording a section in place keeps word-by-word review', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply('Right now the support team spends most of their day answering the same questions.')

test.describe('loading and cancel', () => {
  test('Cancel aborts the request and leaves the document unchanged', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    const aborted = page.waitForEvent('requestfailed', (request) => request.url().includes('/api/suggest'))

    suggest.hang()
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Thinking')
    await expect(page.locator('.blaze-thinking')).not.toHaveCount(0)

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }).click()
    await aborted

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Nothing to review')
    await expect(page.getByText('Cancelled. Your text is unchanged.')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.locator('.blaze-target-block')).toHaveCount(0)
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('cancelling a refine keeps the suggestion', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE, 'First answer.')
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')

    suggest.hang()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Warmer' }).click()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }).click()

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()

  for (const { status, code, message, heading } of [
    {
      status: 500,
      code: 'missing_api_key',
      message: 'No API key found. Add OPENROUTER_API_KEY to your .env file and restart.',
      heading: 'Add your API key',
    },
    {
      status: 402,
      code: 'budget_exhausted',
      message: 'The credit on this API key has run out. Your document is unchanged.',
      heading: 'Out of credit',
    },
  ] as const) {
    test(`${code} says what happened and leaves the document unchanged`, async ({ page, suggest }) => {
      await openApp(page)
      const original = await docText(page)
      suggest.fail(status, code, message)
      await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')

      await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toHaveText(message)
      await expect(card(page)).toContainText(heading)
      expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
    })
  }

  test('an unreachable server says so', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.failNetwork()
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText("Can't reach the server")
  })

  test('a failure makes no second call until Retry, which makes exactly one', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.failNetwork()
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toBeVisible()

    // Long enough for any automatic retry to have shown itself.
    await page.waitForTimeout(500)
    expect(suggest.requests).toHaveLength(1)

    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()

    expect(suggest.requests).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(suggest.requests[1]).toEqual(suggest.requests[0])
  })

  test('a failed refine keeps the suggestion and offers Retry', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE, 'First answer.')
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')

    suggest.failNetwork()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Warmer' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toContainText('Your current suggestion is still here.')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Second answer.')
    expect(suggest.requests[2]).toEqual(suggest.requests[1])
  })
})

test.describe('typing stays typing', () => {
  test('"and/or" in a sentence types a slash and opens nothing', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' }).click()
    await page.keyboard.type('and/or')

    await expect.poll(() => docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('a slash and a question mark in the refine field stay text', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    const field = page.getByLabel(/Tell .* what to change/)
    await field.click()
    await page.keyboard.type('and/or?')

    await expect(field).toHaveValue('and/or?')
    await expect(palette(page)).toBeHidden()
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Shortcuts' })).toBeHidden()
  })
})

test.describe('the / palette', () => {
  test('on an empty line it opens on the current section, and the slash is not typed', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' }).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('End')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await page.keyboard.press('/')

    await expect(palette(page)).toContainText('on “Why now”')
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).not.toContainText('/')
  })

  test('with a selection it runs on the selection, using the arrows and Enter', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await selectText(page, SAFE_SENTENCE)
    await page.keyboard.press('/')
    await expect(palette(page)).toContainText("on “How we'll keep it safe”")

    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown')
    await expect(page.getByRole('option', { selected: true })).toContainText('Shorter')

    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]).toMatchObject({
      target: 'selection',
      selection: SAFE_SENTENCE,
      instruction: 'Make it shorter.',
    })
  })

  test('with nothing selected it acts on the whole section', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' }).click()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Commands/ }).click()
    await expect(palette(page)).toContainText('on “Why now”')

    suggest.reply('The team answers the same questions all day, so harder tickets wait.')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.target).toBe('section')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.selection).toContain('Right now the support team')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.selection).not.toContain('What we')
  })

  test('free text works in the palette', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await selectText(page, SAFE_SENTENCE)
    await page.keyboard.press('/')
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await page.getByLabel(/something else/).fill('Say it in fewer words')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.instruction).toBe('Say it in fewer words')
  })

  test('during a review it refines the suggestion', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('/')
    suggest.reply('We record all suggestions and whether each was accepted')
    await page.getByLabel(/something else/).fill('Use the word record')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')

    await expect(page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Refine history' })).toBeVisible()

      selection: SAFE_SENTENCE,
      currentSuggestion: SAFE_REWRITE,
      instruction: 'Use the word record',
    })
  })

  test('Esc closes it', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Commands/ }).click()
    await expect(palette(page)).toBeVisible()
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(palette(page)).toBeHidden()
  })
})

  })

import { card, docText, expect, openApp, pillCommand, SAFE_REWRITE, SAFE_SENTENCE, selectText, test } from './support.ts'

test.describe('first open', () => {
  test('a new user sees the hint and prompts, and one click gets a suggestion', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    const hint = page.getByText('Select any sentence to ask for a rewrite')
    await expect(hint).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Make / })).toHaveCount(3)

    suggest.reply("We'll know it's working when median first response drops from [X] to [Y] by [date].")
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Make the success metric measurable' }).click()

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    await expect(hint).toBeHidden()
    expect(suggest.requests[0]).toMatchObject({
      target: 'section',
      selection: "We'll know it's working when tickets get answered faster.",
      context: { heading: 'Success metrics' },
    })
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('a prompt disappears with its section and returns on undo', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap h2', { hasText: 'Success metrics' }).click({ clickCount: 3 })
    await page.keyboard.press('Backspace')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Make / })).toHaveCount(2)

    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+z')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Make / })).toHaveCount(3)
  })
})

test.describe('asking', () => {
  test('free text works on the first request, and only the selection is sent', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)

    suggest.reply('Should we log every suggestion and whether it was accepted?')
    await selectText(page, SAFE_SENTENCE)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ask', exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByLabel(/What should/).fill('Turn this into a question')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]).toEqual({
      selection: SAFE_SENTENCE,
      target: 'selection',
      instruction: 'Turn this into a question',
      currentSuggestion: null,
      context: {
        heading: "How we'll keep it safe",
        before: null,
        after: null,
      },
    })
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('suggestions work on text the user just typed', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: "We'll know it's working" }).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('End')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await page.keyboard.type('i think this sentance has a typo')

    suggest.reply('I think this sentence has a typo.')
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'sentance' }).click({ clickCount: 3 })
    await page.getByRole('toolbar').getByRole('button', { name: 'Fix grammar' }).click()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.selection).toBe('i think this sentance has a typo')

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' }).click()
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText('I think this sentence has a typo.')
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).not.toContainText('sentance')
  })
})

test.describe('reviewing', () => {
  test('the diff shows in the card and the document stays as it was', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE, 'Tightened the opening.')
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Tightened the opening.')
    await expect(card(page).locator('del').first()).toBeVisible()
    await expect(card(page).locator('ins').first()).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByText('Change 1 of 2')).toBeVisible()
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('partial accept applies only the kept change, and clicking selects a change', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')

    await card(page).getByRole('button', { name: /^Change 2:/ }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText('Change 2 of 2')).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Previous change' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText('Change 1 of 2')).toBeVisible()

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Keep', exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText('Change 2 of 2')).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Discard', exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply · 1 kept, 1 dropped' }).click()

    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText('We will log every suggestion and whether it was accepted')
  })

  test('the toast Undo restores the document in one step', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' }).click()
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText(SAFE_REWRITE)

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Undo' }).click()
    await expect.poll(() => docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('editing the paragraph discards the suggestion with a notice', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const paragraph = page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Every answer' })
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Rewrite')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    await paragraph.click()
    await page.keyboard.type('x')

    await expect(page.getByText('You edited this text, so the suggestion was discarded.')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Nothing to review')
  })

  test('editing another paragraph keeps the suggestion, and accept lands in the right place', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Rewrite')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' }).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('Home')
    await page.keyboard.type('Added words. ')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' }).click()
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Every answer' })).toContainText(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' })).toContainText('Added words. Right now')
  })
})

test.describe('refining', () => {
  test('a refine sends the original, the current suggestion and the instruction', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    suggest.reply('We will record all suggestions and whether each was accepted')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'More formal' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Refine history' })).toBeVisible()

    suggest.reply('We record all suggestions and whether each was accepted')
    await page.getByLabel(/Tell .* what to change/).fill('Drop the future tense')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Refine history' })).toContainText('Drop the future tense')

    expect(suggest.requests.map((request) => request.selection)).toEqual([SAFE_SENTENCE, SAFE_SENTENCE, SAFE_SENTENCE])
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.currentSuggestion).toBeNull()
    expect(suggest.requests[1]?.currentSuggestion).toBe(SAFE_REWRITE)
    expect(suggest.requests[2]?.instruction).toBe('Drop the future tense')
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('stepping back through the history makes no call', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE, 'First answer.')
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')

    suggest.reply('We will record all suggestions and whether each was accepted', 'Second answer.')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Warmer' }).click()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Second answer.')

    await page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Refine history' }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Shorter' }).click()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')
    expect(suggest.requests).toHaveLength(2)
  })
})

test.describe('restructuring', () => {
  const REORDERED = [
    '- Weekly reviews of what the assistant got wrong so we can actually improve it over time.',
    '- An AI assistant that drafts answers for the most common tickets, which an agent always reviews before sending.',
    '- A shared knowledge base so the assistant and the team are working from the same information.',
  ].join('\n')

  test('a restructured section is one block, all or nothing, and one undo restores it', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap li', { hasText: 'A shared knowledge base' }).click()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Commands/ }).click()

    suggest.reply(REORDERED, 'Moved the weekly reviews to the top.')
    await page.getByLabel(/something else/).fill('Put the weekly reviews first')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('This reorganizes the section')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Before')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('After')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Keep', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Discard', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0)
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.target).toBe('section')
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' }).click()
    const items = page.locator('.tiptap li')
    await expect(items).toHaveCount(3)
    await expect(items.first()).toContainText('Weekly reviews')
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap h2')).toHaveCount(4)

    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+z')
    await expect.poll(() => docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('rewording a section in place keeps word-by-word review', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply('Right now the support team spends most of their day answering the same questions.')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Make “Why now” shorter' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Keep', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    await expect(card(page)).not.toContainText('This reorganizes the section')
  })
})

import { card, docText, expect, openApp, pillCommand, SAFE_REWRITE, SAFE_SENTENCE, test } from './support.ts'

test.describe('loading and cancel', () => {
  test('Cancel aborts the request and leaves the document unchanged', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    const aborted = page.waitForEvent('requestfailed', (request) => request.url().includes('/api/suggest'))

    suggest.hang()
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Thinking')
    await expect(page.locator('.blaze-thinking')).not.toHaveCount(0)

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }).click()
    await aborted

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Nothing to review')
    await expect(page.getByText('Cancelled. Your text is unchanged.')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.locator('.blaze-target-block')).toHaveCount(0)
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('cancelling a refine keeps the suggestion', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE, 'First answer.')
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')

    suggest.hang()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Warmer' }).click()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }).click()

    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' })).toHaveCount(0)
  })
})

test.describe('errors', () => {
  for (const { status, code, message, heading } of [
    {
      status: 500,
      code: 'missing_api_key',
      message: 'No API key found. Add OPENROUTER_API_KEY to your .env file and restart.',
      heading: 'Add your API key',
    },
    {
      status: 402,
      code: 'budget_exhausted',
      message: 'The credit on this API key has run out. Your document is unchanged.',
      heading: 'Out of credit',
    },
  ] as const) {
    test(`${code} says what happened and leaves the document unchanged`, async ({ page, suggest }) => {
      await openApp(page)
      const original = await docText(page)
      suggest.fail(status, code, message)
      await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')

      await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toHaveText(message)
      await expect(card(page)).toContainText(heading)
      expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
    })
  }

  test('an unreachable server says so', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.failNetwork()
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText("Can't reach the server")
  })

  test('a failure makes no second call until Retry, which makes exactly one', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.failNetwork()
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toBeVisible()

    // Long enough for any automatic retry to have shown itself.
    await page.waitForTimeout(500)
    expect(suggest.requests).toHaveLength(1)

    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()

    expect(suggest.requests).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(suggest.requests[1]).toEqual(suggest.requests[0])
  })

  test('a failed refine keeps the suggestion and offers Retry', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE, 'First answer.')
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')

    suggest.failNetwork()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Warmer' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toContainText('Your current suggestion is still here.')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('First answer.')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()

    suggest.reply('We will warmly log all suggestions and whether it was accepted', 'Second answer.')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }).click()
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Second answer.')
    expect(suggest.requests[2]).toEqual(suggest.requests[1])
  })
})

import { card, docText, expect, openApp, outsideEditor, palette, pillCommand, SAFE_REWRITE, SAFE_SENTENCE, selectText, test } from './support.ts'

test.describe('typing stays typing', () => {
  test('"and/or" in a sentence types a slash and opens nothing', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' }).click()
    await page.keyboard.type('and/or')

    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText('and/or')
    await expect(palette(page)).toBeHidden()

    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+z')
    await expect.poll(() => docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('a slash and a question mark in the refine field stay text', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    const field = page.getByLabel(/Tell .* what to change/)
    await field.click()
    await page.keyboard.type('and/or?')

    await expect(field).toHaveValue('and/or?')
    await expect(palette(page)).toBeHidden()
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Shortcuts' })).toBeHidden()
  })
})

test.describe('the / palette', () => {
  test('on an empty line it opens on the current section, and the slash is not typed', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' }).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('End')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await page.keyboard.press('/')

    await expect(palette(page)).toContainText('on “Why now”')
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).not.toContainText('/')
  })

  test('with a selection it runs on the selection, using the arrows and Enter', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await selectText(page, SAFE_SENTENCE)
    await page.keyboard.press('/')
    await expect(palette(page)).toContainText("on “How we'll keep it safe”")

    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown')
    await expect(page.getByRole('option', { selected: true })).toContainText('Shorter')

    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]).toMatchObject({
      target: 'selection',
      selection: SAFE_SENTENCE,
      instruction: 'Make it shorter.',
    })
  })

  test('with nothing selected it acts on the whole section', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.locator('.tiptap p', { hasText: 'Right now' }).click()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Commands/ }).click()
    await expect(palette(page)).toContainText('on “Why now”')

    suggest.reply('The team answers the same questions all day, so harder tickets wait.')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.target).toBe('section')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.selection).toContain('Right now the support team')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.selection).not.toContain('What we')
  })

  test('free text works in the palette', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await selectText(page, SAFE_SENTENCE)
    await page.keyboard.press('/')
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await page.getByLabel(/something else/).fill('Say it in fewer words')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')
    expect(suggest.requests[0]?.instruction).toBe('Say it in fewer words')
  })

  test('during a review it refines the suggestion', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Accept all')

    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('/')
    suggest.reply('We record all suggestions and whether each was accepted')
    await page.getByLabel(/something else/).fill('Use the word record')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')

    await expect(page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Refine history' })).toBeVisible()
    expect(suggest.requests[1]).toMatchObject({
      selection: SAFE_SENTENCE,
      currentSuggestion: SAFE_REWRITE,
      instruction: 'Use the word record',
    })
  })

  test('Esc closes it', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Commands/ }).click()
    await expect(palette(page)).toBeVisible()
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(palette(page)).toBeHidden()
  })
})

test.describe('shortcuts', () => {
  test('Ctrl+Enter accepts all, and Ctrl+Z from outside the editor undoes it', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()

    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+Enter')
    await expect(page.locator('.tiptap')).toContainText(SAFE_REWRITE)

    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+z')
    await expect.poll(() => docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('Esc rejects a suggestion', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    const original = await docText(page)
    suggest.reply(SAFE_REWRITE)
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept all' })).toBeVisible()

    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Nothing to review')
    expect(await docText(page)).toBe(original)
  })

  test('Esc cancels a request in flight', async ({ page, suggest }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    suggest.hang()
    await pillCommand(page, SAFE_SENTENCE, 'Shorter')
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' })).toBeVisible()

    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(card(page)).toContainText('Nothing to review')
  })

  test('Esc closes the pill', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await selectText(page, SAFE_SENTENCE)
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(page.getByRole('toolbar')).toBeHidden()
  })

  test('? opens the shortcuts from outside the editor, and Esc closes them', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await outsideEditor(page).click()
    await page.keyboard.press('?')
    const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Shortcuts' })
    await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(dialog).toBeHidden()
  })

  test('the sidebar buttons open the shortcuts too', async ({ page }) => {
    await openApp(page)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Shortcuts/ }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Shortcuts' })).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Got it' }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Shortcuts' })).toBeHidden()
  })
})

/**

 */
export async function placeCursor(page: Page, selector: string, text: string, edge: 'start' | 'end'): Promise<void> {
  await page.evaluate(
    ({ selector, text, edge }) => {
      const block = [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(selector)].find((element) =>

      document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.tiptap')?.focus()
      const range = document.createRange()
      range.selectNodeContents(block)
      range.collapse(edge === 'start')
      const selection = getSelection()
      selection?.removeAllRanges()
      selection?.addRange(range)

    { selector, text, edge },

/**
 * Puts the cursor at the start or end of a block. Home and End only reach the
 * visual line. The pause matters: ProseMirror learns about the cursor from the
 * selectionchange event, and a script's next key can arrive before it. A person
 * can't type that fast, but a test can, and the key would act on the old position.
 */
export async function placeCursor(page: Page, selector: string, text: string, edge: 'start' | 'end'): Promise<void> {
  await page.evaluate(
    ({ selector, text, edge }) => {
      const block = [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(selector)].find((element) =>
        element.innerText.includes(text),
      )
      if (!block) throw new Error(`Block not found: `+text)
      document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.tiptap')?.focus()
      const range = document.createRange()
      range.selectNodeContents(block)
      range.collapse(edge === 'start')
      const selection = getSelection()
      selection?.removeAllRanges()
      selection?.addRange(range)
    },
    { selector, text, edge },
  )
  await page.waitForTimeout(100)
}

$utf8 = New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false
$mutations = @(
  @{ name = 'Bug 1: focus not returned to the document'
     file = 'src\hooks\useSuggestion.ts'
     find = "editor.commands.focus(undefined, { scrollIntoView: false })"
     with = "void editor"
     grep = 'focus returns' },
  @{ name = 'Bug 2: selection not cleared when asking'
     file = 'src\hooks\useSuggestion.ts'
     find = "if (target.kind === 'selection') editor.commands.setTextSelection(target.to)"
     with = ""
     grep = 'pill comes back' },
  @{ name = 'Bug 3: palette input disabled when it has no target'
     file = 'src\components\CommandPalette\CommandPalette.tsx'
     find = "readOnly={!available}"
     with = "disabled={!available}"
     grep = 'Esc closes the palette when it has no target' }
)
foreach ($m in $mutations) {
  $path = Join-Path $PWD $m.file
  $original = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($path, $utf8)
  if (-not $original.Contains($m.find)) { Write-Output "$($m.name): MARKER NOT FOUND"; continue }
  try {
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $original.Replace($m.find, $m.with), $utf8)
    $out = pnpm --silent exec playwright test e2e/regressions.spec.ts -g $m.grep --timeout 8000 2>$null
    $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    $summary = ($out | Select-String -Pattern '^\s+\d+ (passed|failed)' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }) -join ', '
    $verdict = if ($code -ne 0) { 'CAUGHT' } else { 'NOT CAUGHT' }
    Write-Output "$verdict  $($m.name)  [$summary]"
  } finally {
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $original, $utf8)
  }
}
